name: static-mad-analysis
description: Subject-centered static-MAD analysis through a shared core, with provisional AMV and ASMV extensions.

interface.shortDescription: Static-MAD analysis with provisional AMV and ASMV extensions.
interface.longDescription: Analyze static MAD through adaptive sampling, subject-role tracking, event-response chains, time-space reconstruction, audiovisual organization, and optional cost-gated Qwen video understanding. AMV and ASMV adapters are provisional extensions used only when explicitly requested.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this static MAD with the shared subject-centered core and supported static adapter.
Reconstruct the subjects, event-response chains, and time-space relations in this video.
Experiment with the provisional ASMV extension to analyze speaker roles and audiovisual argument.
